ValidationRule.description: When the payment is made for EMD or Re-Issue, it must be an immediate cheque if pay by cheque.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name != "System Administrator", RecordType.Name = "Payment", ISPICKVAL( Payment_Mode__c , "Cheque"), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Purpose__c , "Issue Ticket")), Cheque_Clearance_Date__c > TODAY() )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The payment for EMD and Re-Issue must be an immediate cheque.
